name: funcandperf
description: API Test Automation & Performance Testing Framework

scripts.test:clean: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report && npx playwright test
scripts.test:calc: npx tsx src/mock/server.ts & sleep 2 && calculator.url=http://localhost:3000 TEST_FILE_PATH=tests/scenarios/calculator-demo.json npx playwright test tests/scenario-loader.spec.ts --reporter=list
scripts.test:ci: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report && npx playwright test || npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.test:allure: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report && (TEST_FILE_PATH=tests/scenarios/working-demo.json npx playwright test tests/scenario-loader.spec.ts || true) && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:allure_mixed: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report && (TEST_FILE_PATH=tests/scenarios/mixed-demo.json npx playwright test tests/scenario-loader.spec.ts || true) && npm run allure:report
scripts.allure:report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.k6:run: K6_SCENARIO_INDEX=1 K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_OPEN=true k6 run --out web-dashboard performance_scripts/k6/performance-test.js
scripts.k6:browser:run:live: K6_BROWSER_MAX_DURATION=2m K6_BROWSER_VUS=2 K6_BROWSER_ITERATIONS=500 K6_BROWSER_SCENARIO_INDEX=3 K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_OPEN=true k6 run --out web-dashboard performance_scripts/k6/browser-performance-test.js
scripts.k6:hybrid:run: K6_BROWSER_MAX_DURATION=2m K6_BROWSER_VUS=2 K6_BROWSER_ITERATIONS=500 K6_HYBRID_SCENARIO_INDEX=3 K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_OPEN=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=results/k6-hybrid-dashboard.html k6 run --out web-dashboard performance_scripts/k6/hybrid-performance-test.js
scripts.k6:all: npm run k6:generate && npm run k6:run:json
scripts.gatling:run: GATLING_USERS_PER_SEC=20 GATLING_SCENARIO_INDEX=9 npx gatling run --sources-folder performance_scripts/gatling --simulation performance-test
scripts.gatling:run:json: npx gatling run --sources-folder performance_scripts/gatling --simulation performance-test --results-folder results/gatling
scripts.gatling:all: npm run gatling:generate && npm run gatling:run
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests playwright.config.ts playwright.unit.config.ts --ext .ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts tests playwright.config.ts playwright.unit.config.ts --ext .ts --fix
scripts.clean: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report playwright-report-unit test-results test-results-parsed.json test-scenarios-temp.json scripts/performance-test.js results performance_scripts gatling/performance-test.gatling.ts gatling-results target features
